alias-of:lydda_741>lod_731@359080.note: 1 Chr 8:12 names Lod beside Ono; Acts 9:32 names Lydda. The text never equates them; the identity is an outside reading.

date:an-angel-rescues-peter-from-prison@.note: Text dates it only by Herod's reign and the days of unleavened bread. The AD 40 year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:disciples-first-called-christians@0.note: Naming at Antioch follows Barnabas fetching Saul. No year is given; AD 40 is outside chronology. Acts 11:28 puts a later famine in Claudius's days.

date:first-missionary-journey-begins@d50.note: Text places the departure after Herod's death and Barnabas and Saul's return. The AD 45 year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:herod-dies@d50e3d.note: Death described at 12:21-23 with no year. AD 45 depends on outside dating; outside sources usually date Agrippa I's death to AD 44.

date:herod-imprisons-peter@0baa0b.note: Text places the arrest in the days of unleavened bread, before Easter. No year is given; AD 40 depends on outside dating.

date:herod-kills-james@0baa0b.note: Text says only 'about that time' (12:1), after relief sent in a famine the text dates to Claudius, who reigned from AD 41. AD 40 is doubtful; the year is outside dating.

died-at:herod_1506>caesarea_266@90aa9d.note: Herod goes down to Caesarea and abides there (12:19); his death comes at that time (12:21-23). Acts says only 'Herod the king'; Agrippa I is an outside identification.

occurred-at:an-angel-rescues-peter-from-.note: The prison's place is not named. 12:19 has Herod go down from Judaea to Caesarea after the escape, which places the events in Judaea.

occurred-at:disciples-first-called-chris.note: 'The disciples were called Christians first in Antioch' (11:26). The 11:19 match mentions Antioch only as a destination of the scattered believers.

occurred-at:first-missionary-journey>jer.note: The journey is sent out from Antioch: Barnabas and Saul are sent away and depart unto Seleucia (13:1-4). Jerusalem is only where they came from (12:25).

occurred-at:herod-dies>caesarea_266@5a78.note: Herod abides at Caesarea (12:19); the death follows with no other place named (12:21-23). The Agrippa I identity is outside Scripture.

occurred-at:herod-imprisons-peter>judea_.note: The arrest's place is not named. Judaea is implied by 12:19, where Herod goes down from Judaea to Caesarea.

occurred-at:herod-kills-james>judea_657@.note: The place of James's death is not named. Judaea is implied only by Herod's later move from Judaea (12:19).

occurred-at:peter-meets-cornelius>caesar.note: They 'entered into Caesarea', and Cornelius met Peter there and fell at his feet (10:24-25).

occurred-at:peter-meets-cornelius>joppa_.note: Peter leaves Joppa with the men and enters Caesarea (10:23-24), where the meeting happens. Joppa is only where Peter was lodged.

occurred-at:peter-preaches-to-gentiles-i.note: Peter enters Caesarea, goes in to Cornelius's house (10:24, 10:27), and preaches there (10:34-43).

occurred-at:saul-is-converted>damascus_3.note: The light shines 'near Damascus' (9:3); Saul is brought into Damascus (9:8), where Ananias lays hands on him (9:17).

occurred-at:saul-is-converted>straight_1.note: Ananias is sent to the house of Judas on the street called Straight (9:11) and enters that house to lay hands on Saul (9:17).

occurred-at:saul-proclaims-jesus>jerusal.note: Saul is coming and going at Jerusalem and speaks boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus (9:28-29).

parent-of:mary_1941>mark_1679@ee8626.note: 'The house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark' (12:12).

part-of:tarsus_1140>cilicia_300@b3feb6.note: Paul says he is 'a Jew of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia' (21:39).

participated-in:aeneas_106>peter-heals-a.note: Aeneas, bedridden eight years (9:33), rises at Peter's word: 'he arose immediately' (9:34).

participated-in:ananias_259>saul-is-conv.note: Ananias is called in a vision (9:10), goes, and puts his hands on Saul (9:17).

participated-in:barnabas_1722>disciples-.note: Barnabas is sent to Antioch (11:22); he and Saul teach a year there, where the name arises (11:26). The text does not say Barnabas named them.

participated-in:barnabas_1722>first-miss.note: Barnabas and Saul are set apart by the Holy Ghost and sent forth (13:2-3), and depart to Seleucia (13:4).
Barnabas and Saul are sent forth by the Holy Ghost and depart (13:2-4).

participated-in:cornelius_956>peter-meet.note: Cornelius waits for Peter, meets him, and falls at his feet (10:24-25).

participated-in:dorcas_2810>peter-heals-.note: At Peter's word 'Tabitha, arise' she opens her eyes and sits up (9:40), and is presented alive (9:41).

participated-in:herod_1506>herod-dies@54.note: 'Herod the king' makes an oration on a set day, and is smitten and dies (12:21-23). The Agrippa I identity is outside Scripture.

participated-in:herod_1506>herod-impriso.note: 'Herod the king' seizes Peter and puts him in prison (12:3-4). The Agrippa I identity is outside Scripture.

participated-in:herod_1506>herod-kills-j.note: 'Herod the king' kills James with the sword (12:1-2). The Agrippa I identity is outside Scripture.

participated-in:holy_spirit_7400>peter-m.note: The Spirit tells Peter that three men seek him and says 'I have sent them' (10:19-20). The Spirit is not named in the meeting itself.

participated-in:holy_spirit_7400>peter-p.note: The Holy Ghost falls on all who heard Peter's word (10:44), and the gift is poured out on the Gentiles (10:45).

participated-in:holy_spirit_7400>saul-is.note: Ananias says Saul will be filled with the Holy Ghost (9:17). The text gives the filling as a purpose, not as an act within the conversion.

participated-in:mark_1679>first-missiona.note: John Mark is their minister at Salamis (13:5), and he departs from Paul's company at Perga (13:13).
They depart unto Seleucia and sail to Cyprus, 'and they had also John to their minister' (13:4-5).

participated-in:paul_2479>disciples-firs.note: Barnabas brings Saul to Antioch, and the two teach there a whole year, where the disciples are first called Christians (11:25-26). The naming is not attributed to Saul.

participated-in:paul_2479>first-missiona.note: Saul, 'who also is called Paul', is sent out with Barnabas (13:2) and confronts Elymas on the journey (13:9).
Saul is sent forth with Barnabas by the Holy Ghost and departs (13:2-4).

participated-in:paul_2479>saul-is-conver.note: Saul falls to the earth and asks, 'Lord, what wilt thou have me to do?' (9:4-6).

participated-in:peter_2745>an-angel-resc.note: Peter is raised, girds himself, and goes out after the angel (12:7-9).

participated-in:peter_2745>herod-impriso.note: Peter is seized and put in prison by Herod, and guarded by four quaternions of soldiers (12:3-4).

participated-in:peter_2745>peter-heals-a.note: Peter tells Aeneas 'Jesus Christ maketh thee whole' (9:34) and raises Dorcas (9:40).

participated-in:peter_2745>peter-meets-c.note: Peter goes down to Cornelius's men (10:21), and tells Cornelius, 'I myself also am a man' (10:26).

participated-in:peter_2745>peter-preache.note: Peter opens his mouth and preaches; all the prophets witness to Jesus (10:34-43).

visited:aeneas_106>lydda_741@9d3784.note: Peter comes to the saints at Lydda, and there he finds Aeneas (9:32-33).
